method: All 240 legacy prompts inspected for scope, ambiguity and attribution. Source-led selection and rewriting of 40; not count-only truncation. Each selected answer and quoted passage reviewed in actual retrieved text or indexed primary-text excerpt, distinguished item by item. Foreign passages translated or paraphrased in Arabic; no claim of canonical translation.

tierRationale.200: Familiar Arabic school poetry, widely known philosophical phrase and iconic lunar words.
tierRationale.400: Common literary openings and quotations requiring recall of author association.
tierRationale.600: Reader/enthusiast knowledge of a named work or source context.
tierRationale.800: Less familiar prose, poetry and scientific-paper quotations with identifying context.
tierRationale.1000: Specialist poets, philosophy and computing sources. Targets are editorial estimates, not tested success rates.

retiredPolicy: All 240 old IDs replaced with 901–908 range; shared retired registry is integration-owned.

corrections.issue: Wrongly attributed وطني لو شغلت بالخلد عنه to Ibrahim Touqan; corrected to Ahmad Shawqi after reading the published Shawqiyyat text.
Malformed تعب كلهم في الحياة replaced by exact تعب كلها الحياة.
Newton wording now specifies his letter to Hooke; no claim that Newton originated the older giants metaphor.
Jobs retained as the Stanford speech speaker, not originator of Whole Earth Catalog wording.
Mahfouz wrote the Nobel lecture; question no longer implies he personally delivered it.
Beckett quote correctly grouped as prose, not theater.

scopeDecision: Retired political/ruler speeches, religious teaching outside designated religious packs, disputed anecdotes, and nonselected material. Retirement alone does not label every rejected quotation false.
